error_message: Per-value text formatting plus SHA-256 was resource-inefficient; no semantic output was accepted. Partition-local candidate provenance audit contained one extra closing parenthesis. Corrected and pre-validated on one full partition; producer outputs were not rewritten.

The Codex network/UI stream was interrupted after all 181 producer checkpoints had completed. Recovery inspection found no active prior writer, no partial artifacts, and no duplicate execution; all producer outputs were physically verified and reused.
